comments.content: Bug: this branch handles the vertical case (`fabs(line.x) < FLT_EPSILON`) but returns `DimensionGeometry::isHorizontal`. The original code returned `TechDraw::isVertical`. This should be `DimensionGeometry::isVertical`.

Bug: in `isValidSingleEdge`, the vertical branch (`fabs(line.x) < FLT_EPSILON`) returns `DimensionGeometry::isHorizontal` instead of `DimensionGeometry::isVertical`. The original code returned `TechDraw::isVertical`.
Bug: in `isValidVertexes`, the vertical branch (`fabs(line.x) < FLT_EPSILON`) returns `DimensionGeometry::isHorizontal` instead of `DimensionGeometry::isVertical`. The original returned `isVertical`.

Bug: in `isValidVertexes3d`, the vertical branch (`fabs(line.x) < FLT_EPSILON`) returns `DimensionGeometry::isHorizontal` instead of `DimensionGeometry::isVertical`. The original returned `isVertical`.

The `getDirsFromFront` no-match fallback (previously logging an error and returning the anchor's Front direction) has been commented out rather than removed. For `ProjDirection::Front` (a valid enum value), none of the if/else branches match, so `projDir`/`rotVec` remain at their initialized defaults instead of the Front direction. Please verify Front is never passed here, or restore an explicit Front handling / default case.
This dangling commented-out `default:` block (leftover from the removed switch) is orphaned inside the else branch and should be deleted rather than left as dead comment code.
Remove this leftover commented-out line `//using ProjDirection = ProjDirection` (also malformed/self-referential); it is dead code.
